entries.mitigation: Tank Poxito on a saw track and line up an activated saw blade through the boss as soon as Bone Armor appears.
Totems first. Kill every Bone Effigy before the expanding Soul Storm reaches the room edge; living totems turn the finish into a wipe.
DD priority target. Kill immediately so specters stop spawning and cannot drag players onto traps.
Tank taunts quickly; group kills or cleaves it before Blood Frenzy cones through a DD or healer.
Avoid accidental plate triggers and saw paths. Only use the saw deliberately to strip Bone Armor.
Do not stack statue deaths. Tank moves the boss and live adds out of every Fatal Pool immediately because enemies inside become invulnerable.
Block or shield every ring as it crosses you. Dodge does not prevent the hit, and the pulses ramp over time.
Stay out of the skull-to-add tether lines and kill the tethered adds to end Death Essence phases.
Prefer ranged taunts and spacing over stacking/gripping statues together; one dead statue should not make the next target immune.
Put one player in each guardian circle. Tank and healer are a clean default assignment so both circles are reliably occupied.
Drop persistent pools toward the arena edge, then move out immediately so the center stays usable.
Follow behind Talen-Lah during the walk and dodge or sidestep the outward pools; the boss ignores normal tank positioning during it.
Keep peripheral vision on the arena edges and avoid the bouncing boulders; player contact can split them into additional hazards.
